US Supreme Court Rules on Transgender Athlete Participation in Sports

The US Supreme Court has upheld state bans preventing transgender athletes from participating in female sports teams. The ruling allows states to restrict participation based on biological sex. This decision has been framed as a setback for the LGBTQ+ community by some outlets, while others highlight its significance for President Trump's administration.
